name: d1_gods
description: D1 headless demonstration: a god-only population game (watch seat, HumanGod 0) with six persistent gods. God 1 is an AI-seated ScheduleGod spending Mythic through the test-only DivineTestSpend command (no effect besides the spend and the intervention record): a miracle-kind spend of 5 Mythic every day from tick 600 and one command-kind spend of 12 Mythic at tick 3000. The other gods are IdleGod. Divinity.Mode can be switched from the command line (2 = Disabled refuses everything).
